desc:
Equistride [PUBLIC BETA] is a new horse game in the beta testing phase. 

Saddle up and explore a world of horses in this new equestrian game! Train, ride, and care for your horses, discover unique breeds, and compete in thrilling events. Whether you're racing, trail riding, competing or just bonding with your horse, adventure awaits!

[DISCLAIMER] The game will be free eventually. Only buy the game if you are okay with spending robux on something that will be free.
